chunks: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Ja'far ibn Jami' al-Himyari narrated to us from his father, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid. He said: al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal narrated to us from Abu'l-Hasan Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him), from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Ali is from me, and I am from 'Ali. May God fight whoever fights 'Ali. May God curse whoever opposes 'Ali. 'Ali is the Imam of all creation after me. Whoever approaches 'Ali has approached me, and whoever departs from him has departed from me. Whoever gives preference over him has given preference over me. I am at peace with whoever is at peace with him, and at war with whoever is at war with him. I am the ally of whoever aligns with him, and the enemy of whoever is his enemy.

key_terms.آثر: To prefer or give priority to (someone over another) — implying placing another person above Ali in rank or authority
key_terms.إمام الخليقة: Imam of all creation — a title establishing Ali's universal authority over all created beings after the Prophet
key_terms.سِلم / حَرب: Peace / War — the Prophet's alignment with whoever aligns or conflicts with Ali, indicating complete spiritual and political unity between them

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the relationship between himself and Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits a sweeping prophetic declaration of Imam Ali's (AS) unparalleled status through the chain of the Imams, reaching back to the Prophet (SAWW) himself. The Prophet explicitly identified Ali as an extension of himself — sharing in his essence, mission, and spiritual reality — and declared Ali's Imamate over all of creation. The declaration was understood by the early community as establishing the doctrinal foundation for Ali's succession: those who align with Ali align with the Prophet, and those who oppose Ali oppose the Prophet himself.
